gloss: Dogo Onsen (ancient hot spring in Matsuyama)

definitions.explanation: A hot spring in Matsuyama, Ehime Prefecture, on Shikoku, said to be one of the oldest in Japan. Its wooden public bathhouse, {道後温泉本館|どうごおんせんほんかん} (1894), is a symbol of the city, and the spring appears in Natsume Soseki's novel Botchan.
